THE HARBOUR GAZETTE
1912-04-16

STEAMER DELAYED BY ICE

The coastal steamer Northern Star was held near Cape
Spear for two days by heavy pack ice. All passengers
are safe. The ship is expected in St. John's harbour
on Thursday morning.

THE AVALON WEEKLY
1915-06-03

FISH PRICES RISE AT THE WATERFRONT

Merchants report that the price of dried cod rose
this week after a poor spring catch. Fishermen from
Petty Harbour say the boats returned with half their
usual load.

1921-09-01

NEW SCHOOL OPENS ON MONDAY

The new school on Water Street will open its doors
to sixty pupils on Monday. Parents are asked to
bring their children at nine o'clock. Books will be
given free of charge.
